scenes.setting: Above the gray fog, weighing whether to report Mr. A's gathering (and doom a room of innocents to Aurora corruption) — until the joyous, helpless truth lands: 'There's only one believer and adorer of The Fool! And that's me!' The answer sent down is two words: don't worry
scenes.text_anchor: “There’s only one believer and adorer of The Fool! And that’s me!”

scenes.setting: Fors learns the Aurora Order serves the True Creator — so this is god against god — reports Lawrence's death, notebook and characteristic, is told to 'follow the true desires in your heart', and trades 600 pounds for the Sheriff characteristic
scenes.text_anchor: “Follow the true desires in your heart.”

scenes.setting: Counting cash at the mottled table: 1,230 pounds, still short for one Sequence 6 ingredient — so the Werewolf characteristic will be sold far away in the Sonia Sea through Mr. Hanged Man, with The World brokering and a commission attached
scenes.text_anchor: Where else can I get money these days?

scenes.setting: Wednesday: Desi pie and sweet iced tea, then a count of every ingredient channel he has — including one vampire; at the Harvest Church, Emlyn polishes candle lamps looking like he'd rather be dead until he spots Klein: 'You came here suddenly because you have something you need my help with, right?'
scenes.text_anchor: as though he would rather be dead
